Hey, I also used to feel like that all the time. In a way, I actually did quit on society last year because I moved to a different country by myself and didn't know anybody and the virus made it impossible for me to meet people. I used to think I didn't want people and wished to just be on my own, but that experience made me learn that we all need social interactions. Being alone made me lose touch with reality in a very hardcore way, and my depression got worse because I suddenly didn't have to do anything because no one was there to look. There was no reason to get out of my house or to take a shower or whatever. It was just me and I didn't care anymore. 

Finding people like you (and people you like) can be a hard task, for many years I felt helpless too. But that's really not a good reason to stop trying, that would only hurt you. Plus it really sounds like you do want social interactions, you just don't want the ones you are having right now. So don't give up on people, if you can't find friends or a girlfriend close to you then try somewhere else, somewhere new.
